# Wisepops

WisePops helps you design smart pop-ups for your website to increase sign-ups and conversions

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wisepops/.

## Actions

- **Create Webhook**: Create a webhook to receive real-time data updates when forms are collected in Wisepops.
- **Delete User Data for Privacy Compliance**: Automatically delete and suppress data about end-users for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
- **Get Wisepops Performance Data** (read-only): Retrieve a list of your Wisepops with display and conversion metrics.
- **Retrieve Collected Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve contacts collected through Wisepops opt-in forms.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete an existing webhook by its hook_id.
